domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain covers the determination of solution sets that satisfy customer requirements across marketing and engagement, recruitment and admissions, student experience, advancement and alumni relations, along with K-12 customer solutions for various educational institutions.

study_focus: Install and configure Salesforce for Education solutions
domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses directly on capabilities and considerations of Education Cloud, including compatibility with other Salesforce products and features, and the detailed procedures for installing and configuring Salesforce for Education solutions for your clients.

study_focus: Illustrate governance and change management best practices
domain_guidance.summary: This domain addresses planning, requirements gathering, design, build, test, documentation, deployment, optimization, governance, change management, staffing, implementation strategies, deployment considerations, adoption best practices, and community resources for long-term solution success within the Education Cloud ecosystem.

study_focus: Design scalable solutions for education customers
domain_guidance.summary: This domain involves evaluating account model considerations against standard account-contact data models, designing appropriate and scalable solutions for education customers, and locating community and open-source solutions and resources effectively for your specific project needs.

study_focus: Explain data management and migration considerations
domain_guidance.summary: This domain centers on integration considerations for connecting systems in an Education Cloud implementation, and explaining data management considerations including data usage, forecasting, large data volumes, and data migrations for various educational data sets.

study_focus: Demonstrate when data analytics solutions apply
domain_guidance.summary: This domain examines reporting solutions within Education Cloud and determines when specific data analytics solutions are appropriate for educational institutions, organizations, and stakeholders during deployments to ensure that all reporting requirements are met successfully.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time carefully across the 60 questions during the 105 minutes. Read each multiple choice and multiple select question carefully before selecting your answers to ensure accuracy and improve your chances of passing.

faq.answer_text: The exam consists of a total of 60 multiple choice and multiple select questions delivered in a linear format to test your knowledge and consulting expertise regarding the platform.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Candidates must achieve a minimum passing score of 62 in order to successfully pass the Salesforce Certified Education Cloud Consultant certification exam and earn the professional credential.
The allotted duration for the exam is 105 minutes. Plan your time carefully during the test to complete all questions within this designated time period without rushing through sections.
This exam is officially scheduled for retirement on 2027-02-01, with no named successor designated by Salesforce at this particular time in the official program guidelines for consultants.
faq.question_title: What is the retirement status of this exam?

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Salesforce Certified Education Cloud Consultant exam, which is scheduled for retirement on 2027-02-01.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official Salesforce exam guides, landing pages, and study documentation to provide factual details and domain structures for all certification candidates.

editorial.overview: The Salesforce Certified Education Cloud Consultant exam, certified by Salesforce, covers domain expertise, configuration, implementation strategies, solution design, integration, data management, and analytics. Candidates face 60 questions during a 105-minute testing period. The exam costs $200.0 with a $100.0 retake fee, requires a passing score of 62, and is officially scheduled for retirement on 2027-02-01. This certification validates your ability to manage complex educational implementations effectively.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review domain weights carefully to allocate study time effectively across all six domains found within the official guide. Focus heavily on configuration capabilities, data management considerations, and integration requirements. Practice applying implementation strategies and best practices for long-term solution success and optimal deployment results across all student lifecycle domains. Ensure you understand the relationship between account models and standard data structures to succeed on the exam.
editorial.who_should_take: Consultants and professionals with implementation experience across K-12 and higher education solutions, focusing specifically on marketing, engagement, recruitment, admissions, student experience, and advancement roles within educational institutions seeking to validate their professional expertise.

exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. No access to Salesforce org. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name must match Webassessor registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Salesforce retires the Education Cloud Consultant certification on February 1, 2027 (last exam date August 31, 2026). The issuer's 2027 retirements FAQ path forward: 'To continue your certification journey, take the following exams to validate your foundational knowledge: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator exam; Salesforce Certified Data 360 Consultant exam.' These are related foundational exams, not a replacement.

recommended_experience: 2+ years of Salesforce Platform experience, 1+ years of Salesforce implementation experience in the education industry, implemented and supported at least one project involving Education Cloud
renewal_options: Salesforce releases three major updates per year. For each release, certified professionals must complete a free maintenance module on Trailhead to retain their certification. No cost for maintenance.

retake_policy.notes: Retake available after scheduling (no mandatory waiting period for first retake). Retake fee ~$100 for most exams.

target_audience: Consultants who have experience implementing Salesforce for Education solutions

testing_centers.notes: In-person and online proctored via Kryterion Webassessor
